summary: Verified the CentralInboxPage fix for the reported bug. Backend: pytest 10/10 pass (test_rab_submissions.py). Frontend Playwright (public URL) drove full flows and all 5 UI assertions PASSED: (1) After Manager approves, RAB with status MENUNGGU PEMESANAN appears in Sekretaris Divisi /inbox with data-testid inbox-rab-{id} and opens detail via open-inbox-rab-{id}; (2) After Koordinator revises, RAB with status PERLU REVISI PIC appears in PIC Accounting /inbox and opens detail; (3) Role selector now persists via localStorage (flowhub-demo-role) across full reloads; (4) Non-eligible roles (Koordinator) see AccessDenied on /inbox; (5) Existing workflow buttons still operate - Sekretaris successfully clicked mark-ticket-hotel-booked-button, backend status became TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI and the RAB disappeared from Sekretaris inbox. Status filtering (PERLU REVISI PIC for PIC, MENUNGGU PEMESANAN for Secretary) is correctly enforced client-side.
critical_code_review_comments: CentralInboxPage.js is written as a single-line JSX return (~1.5 KB) which hurts readability - consider formatting.
No dedicated /api/rab-submissions/{id} GET endpoint - inbox and detail page still fetch the full list.
PERLU REVISI PIC has no resubmit path - after revision the RAB is stuck in PIC inbox; add an endpoint/UI to push it back to MENUNGGU KOORDINATOR.
action endpoint overwrites component_notes on each stage - previous reviewer notes are lost; consider per-role notes map or an approvals[] audit trail.
RABSubmissionCreate.items uses List[dict] with no schema - add a Pydantic ItemModel with label/price/proof_url.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_INBOX_SEC_A (advanced to TIKET DAN HOTEL DIKONFIRMASI) and TEST_INBOX_PIC_B (PERLU REVISI PIC) via /api/rab-submissions during testing; still present in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CentralInboxPage now correctly filters rab_submissions by role (PIC->PERLU REVISI PIC, Sekretaris->MENUNGGU PEMESANAN) and gates access via AccessDenied for other roles. Role selector persists in localStorage key 'flowhub-demo-role'. Backend action payload requires actor_role (not role). Full workflow endpoints unchanged and functional.
rca of the issue: Fixed. Root cause was that the old /inbox InboxPage.js only surfaced trip-based bookings via getTrips filtered by MENUNGGU PEMESANAN and never queried the centralized /api/rab-submissions collection, so Sekretaris Divisi could not see fully-approved RABs and PIC Accounting could not see revised RABs. Fix (CentralInboxPage.js) calls getRabSubmissions() and filters by role-appropriate status; App.js routes /inbox to CentralInboxPage. Verified end-to-end on the public preview URL.
